production.note: US model years from 2020 ("2020 SSC Tuatara Debuts With 1,750 HP, Wild Looks"). Production of customer cars began in 2019 (motorauthority-tuatara-delivery, Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 29 July 2019: "Pre-production of the Tuatara has been up and running ... for several months"; first delivery planned for 16 August 2019). SSC's 2018 release (ssc-tuatara-release-2018) says production is limited to a 100-unit run. No end of production was found, so endYear is null.

body.note: SSC spec table: "Design Configuration" / "Coupe"; two-seat mid-engined coupe.

configuration.note: SSC spec table: "Powertrain Configuration" / "Mid-Engine SSC V8"

displacementL.note: SSC: "Twin-turbo 5.9 liter V8"; no cc figure found.

fuel.note: Flex-fuel: rated on 91-octane gasoline and on E85.

transmission.note: Quote (SSC spec table): "Drivetrain Configuration" / "CIMA 7 Speed Robotized Manual"; Motor Authority: "seven-speed automated manual transmission". Supercars.net (supercars-net-tuatara) wrongly calls it a "CIMA 7-speed semi-automatic dual-clutch".

powerHp.note: SSC's maximum rating, on E85, stored as published (powerStandard Other; SSC does not name a standard). Quote (SSC model page): "Horsepower [E85]" / "1,750 HP"; on 91 octane: "1350 HORSEPOWER". SSC release (2018): "1,750 horsepower / E85 Fuel", "1,350 horsepower / 91 Octane Fuel".

weightLb.note: DRY weight (step 4), SSC's figure in lb. Quote (SSC model page): "Dry Weight" / "2750 LBS". Motor Authority (motorauthority-tuatara-2018): "the dry weight of the Tuatara come in at only 2,750 pounds"; Motor1 (2020): "dry weight of 2,750 pounds (1,247 kilograms)". No curb weight from SSC or a major magazine was found; The Drive (James Gilboy, 16 January 2020) reported only "an anticipated curb weight of below 3,000 pounds". Supercars.net (supercars-net-tuatara) mislabels the same 2,750 lb as "curb weight"; SSC labels it dry.
